name: robots/snu-pi__humanoidtoolbench
title: HumanoidToolBench G1BallMove-L0-S (MuJoCo G1 tool-use simulation)
intro: HumanoidToolBench G1BallMove-L0-S (MuJoCo G1 tool-use simulation), adapted from snu-pi/humanoidtoolbench. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
